resources.string: Uses the compact controller layout with smaller on-screen buttons, so you can see more of the game. On-screen camera controls are disabled while it is on. Recommended when playing with a controller.\n\nApplies when a controller is connected as the game starts. Connect your controller before starting the game: a controller connected later only gets its sticks working after a restart. If the HUD does not change straight away, restart the game.

Choose your HUD:

• Controller HUD: a compact layout with smaller on-screen buttons, so you can see more of the game. Recommended when playing with a controller. On-screen camera controls are disabled with it.

• Touch HUD: the original layout with all touch controls and touch-control options.

Your controller works with either HUD. Connect your controller before starting the game: a controller connected later only gets its sticks working after a restart.

To change your mind later: long-press the game icon on the home screen and choose Controller settings. There you can switch the Controller HUD on or off, and turn on "Ask when the game starts" to see this question again if you ticked "Don't ask again". Changes there may need a game restart to take effect.
